roles.description: Your playable comic fraudster needs a distinctive, expressive 2D silhouette and readable run, jump, fall, landing, hurt, and dialogue poses suited to side-view platforming.
roles.label: Gireesam player character

roles.description: Your pursuing creditor needs a clearly different 2D silhouette with readable chase, obstacle-crossing, attack or catch, setback, and reaction animation states.
roles.label: Comic creditor chaser

roles.description: Your three short stages need readable side-view rooftops, ledges, market stalls, and route boundaries in warm dusk colors, with traversable surfaces clearly separated from background scenery.
roles.label: Vizianagaram-inspired route kit

roles.description: Your collectible coins need a prominent 2D pickup silhouette, a simple attention-catching animation, and space for the Telugu label to remain legible without obscuring play.
roles.label: “సంస్కరణ నిధి” collectible

roles.description: Your stage destination needs a recognizable 2D safe-house entrance or marker with inactive, active, and reached states that remain visible against the town palette.
roles.label: Safe house and checkpoint goal

roles.description: Your Telugu choice moments need expressive 2D portraits or staged character poses for Gireesam, the creditor, and only the recurring townspeople required by the authored dialogue, showing manipulation and visible consequences.
roles.label: Dialogue character reactions

roles.description: Your rooftop and market routes need only the hazard visuals required by the authored stages, with clear silhouettes and warning, active, and impact states.
roles.label: Readable route hazards

roles.description: Your compact interface needs readable hand-painted frames for coins, “ఆబోరు” reputation, objectives, choices, pause, and outcomes while leaving all Telugu typography crisp and unobstructed.
roles.label: Telugu HUD and dialogue frames
